Departments With High Earners

MediumFreeQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEs

Write a SQL query using EXISTS to find departments that have at least one employee earning over $90,000. Return distinct department names. Order alphabetically by department.

Solve it in the browser editor →

Runs on SQLite in your browser, graded against the expected result, no signup. A wrong answer gets a diagnosis, not just "incorrect".

Schema

employees

emp_idnamedepartmentpositionsalaryhire_datemanager_idperformance_rating
1Alice JohnsonEngineeringSenior Developer950002019-03-1554.5
2Bob SmithEngineeringDeveloper750002020-06-0113.8
3Carol WilliamsMarketingMarketing Manager850002018-09-20NULL4.2

Expected output: Engineering appears in result

Hint

Use WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department = e.department AND e2.salary > 90000)
